description: Three illusory duplicates appear in your space. Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the duration, roll 1d6 for each remaining duplicate. If any die is a 3 or higher, one duplicate is hit instead of you and destroyed. Duplicates ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed. A creature is unaffected if it has the Blinded condition or perceives you with Blindsight or Truesight.
name: Mirror Image
